title: 💠 The fourth violating tanker exploded on the unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz
text:
💠 The fourth violating tanker exploded on the unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz"
"IRGC Navy Public Relations:"

"🔹 Yesterday afternoon, October 30th,  the fourth supertanker, ignoring the IRGC Navy’s warnings against transiting the unauthorized southern route of the Strait of Hormuz, suffered a severe explosion after hitting a mine and is burning."

""
"🔹 This violating tanker, carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, also attempted to exit via the unauthorized southern route of the Strait of Hormuz, disregarding the IRGC Navy’s radio warnings."

"🔹 This is the fourth tanker that has been burning since the early hours of yesterday in the fire of American seditions in the Strait of Hormuz."

"Source: IRGC
